title: A Year Ago: Haiti

body: This short interview with Spencer Burke and Kent Annan deserves your attention. I read a lot of manuscripts, but Kent’s Aftershock (a theological-spiritual reflection on the earthquake) is probably the best-written book that’s come across my desk in a long time – moving, insightful, disturbing, genuine, and humane.
